When you send a request with the service_tier parameter set to "priority", Databricks admits the request ahead of standard traffic.

Provider Model Endpoint name Notes
OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol databricks-gpt-5-6-sol
Google Gemini 3.5 Flash databricks-gemini-3-5-flash Available on the global endpoint only. Requires cross geography routing.
Alibaba Cloud Qwen3.5 122B A10B databricks-qwen35-122b-a10b This model is available in preview. Reach out to your account team for enablement. Available only in the ap-south-1 region.

If priority capacity is fully subscribed, requests are served at standard pay-per-token availability and billed at standard pay-per-token rates.
